canonical_subject_rule.algorithm: UTF-8 JSON parse followed by json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',', ':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False) and one trailing LF
canonical_subject_rule.boundary: This tests the complete admission pipeline. It does not claim that cosign, TUF, or in-toto natively treat arbitrary JSON byte changes as equivalent.
canonical_subject_rule.purpose: Registered semantic re-encodings map to one subject byte string before native signing.

materialization: git cat-file blob <blob_sha> > subject.json; the resulting bytes are the signed target before registered transformations
subject_type: Git blob containing a frozen ORION-25 JSON result
